findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fleet_list_services, fleet_get_service, fleet_get_auth · Private data: resource_get, datagov_get_record, loc_get_item, loc_get_resource_links, convert2doc · Public sink: social-post, webhook_verify, email_checker · Destructive: loc_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fleet_list_services, fleet_get_service, fleet_get_auth · Private data: resource_get, datagov_get_record, loc_get_item, loc_get_resource_links, convert2doc · Public sink: social-post, webhook_verify, email_checker · Destructive: loc_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
